item.name: Catalog
item.description: Runs against a fresh seed. It searches, opens the demo manicurist's (Maria's) public page, sends her seed profile back unchanged, and creates, edits and removes a service of its own, so the folder can be run any number of times and leaves the demo data as the seed made it.

exec: pm.test('"софия" finds only manicurists in София', () => { pm.expect(manicurists).to.not.be.empty; manicurists.forEach((m) => pm.expect(m.city).to.eql('София')); });
pm.test('every result offers a service with "гел" in its name', () => manicurists.forEach((m) => pm.expect(m.services.some((s) => s.name.toLowerCase().includes('гел'))).to.be.true));

item.name: Remove the same day off again (404)
Bookings
item.description: Runs against a fresh seed. It finds the demo client's upcoming booking with the demo manicurist (Maria), books the first free slot on that day and cancels it again. Then it opens Maria's packed day, where the seed booking «Парафинова терапия за ръце» ends at 12:10, off the 30-minute grid: it checks that 12:10 is offered and that the busy intervals carry only startAt and endAt, books 12:10 right after that booking and cancels it again. So the folder can be run any number of times.

exec: pm.test('returns upcoming and past lists', () => { pm.expect(upcoming).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(past).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('has an upcoming booking with the demo manicurist', () => pm.expect(seeded).to.be.an('object'));
pm.test('the nested users have no email', () => { pm.expect(seeded.client).to.not.have.property('email'); pm.expect(seeded.manicurist).to.not.have.property('email'); });
// The seed books it at 11:00 Sofia time, so its UTC date is also the Sofia date.
// The packed day: the seed booking «Парафинова терапия за ръце» ends at 12:10 Sofia time, off the grid.
const packed = upcoming.find((b) => b.status === 'BOOKED' && b.serviceName === 'Парафинова терапия за ръце' && b.manicurist.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('manicuristId')));
pm.test('has the packed-day booking that ends off the grid', () => pm.expect(packed).to.be.an('object'));
// It ends at 12:10 Sofia time, so its UTC date is also the Sofia date.
pm.test('is a working day with free slots', () => { pm.expect(dayOff).to.eql(false); pm.expect(slots.length).to.be.above(0); });

pm.test('lists the busy intervals with only startAt and endAt', () => { pm.expect(busy).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; busy.forEach((b) => pm.expect(Object.keys(b).sort()).to.eql(['endAt', 'startAt'])); });
pm.test('the booked start is not offered', () => pm.expect(slots).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('seedStartAt')));

item.name: Free slots for an unknown service (404)

exec: pm.test('is booked at the chosen start', () => { pm.expect(booking.status).to.eql('BOOKED'); pm.expect(booking.startAt).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('slotStartAt')); });

pm.test('is cancelled by the client with the reason', () => { pm.expect(booking.status).to.eql('CANCELLED'); pm.expect(booking.cancelledBy).to.eql('CLIENT'); pm.expect(booking.cancelReason).to.eql('Няма да успея да дойда.'); });

item.name: Free slots on the packed day (200)

exec: pm.test('offers the end of the booking before as a start, off the grid', () => pm.expect(slots).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('packedStartAt')));

pm.test('lists the busy intervals with no names, only startAt and endAt', () => { pm.expect(busy).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; busy.forEach((b) => pm.expect(Object.keys(b).sort()).to.eql(['endAt', 'startAt'])); });
pm.test('one busy interval ends at that start', () => pm.expect(busy.map((b) => b.endAt)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('packedStartAt')));

item.name: Book right after an active booking (201)

exec: pm.test('is booked at the end of the booking before', () => { pm.expect(booking.status).to.eql('BOOKED'); pm.expect(booking.startAt).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('packedStartAt')); });

item.name: Cancel the booking right after an active booking (200)

exec: pm.test('is cancelled by the client', () => { const { booking } = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(booking.status).to.eql('CANCELLED'); pm.expect(booking.cancelledBy).to.eql('CLIENT'); });
